text: The team assessed feasibility and cost risk of offering multiple LED colours, noting customer choice at purchase is not supported.
Decisions include pursuing five fronts on the market, and moving nonessential buttons to the bottom.
A collaboration is planned to ID and sketch the UI prototype on a smart board with owners MTD014ID and MTD015UID.

UI tasks include diagnosing and restoring the UI power indicator state (MTD015UID); delivering the UI design to the team; opening image assets and prototype paint (MTD015UID); and clarifying ambiguous meanings in design notes.
An existing UX issue is noted: volume and channel controls at the bottom are hard to reach with a thumb.
